name: blaze_rod
description: Near a fortress in the Nether, kill blazes for a rod.
goal: Blazes are attacking you in a nether arena. Kill them and get at least 1 blaze rod. Put your armour on first (equip each piece), then use your bow on them (shoot(blaze)) since they fly out of sword reach; melee only when one drops next to you. Eat if you fall below half health. Say 'got a rod' when you have one.
